title: Explain the internal working of the CLR and garbage collection.

data.text: **Question:** Explain the internal working of the CLR and garbage collection.

The CLR (Common Language Runtime) is the execution engine for .NET applications. It manages memory through garbage collection (GC), which automatically reclaims memory from objects that are no longer referenced.

**CLR Components:**
- **Class Loader:** Loads types into memory
- **JIT Compiler:** Converts IL to native code
- **Garbage Collector:** Manages memory allocation and cleanup
- **Security Manager:** Enforces code access security
- **Thread Manager:** Manages threads and synchronization

**Garbage Collection:**
- Based on generations (0, 1, 2)
- Gen 0: short-lived objects, collected frequently
- Gen 1: medium-lived objects
- Gen 2: long-lived objects, collected rarely
- Uses mark-and-compact algorithm
